Initial release of the Email Template skill.

- Provides a library of email templates for welcome, newsletter, transactional, cold outreach, follow-up, and collection scenarios.
- Includes commands to generate each template type.
- Templates output in Markdown for easy copying and editing.
- Offers customization options such as subject line variants and tone adjustment.
- Includes practical tips for subject line optimization to improve open rates.
